execution_eligibility_policy.rule: A missing, stale or failed execution-day field sets q=0 and prevents the affected sleeve from receiving capital.

fallback_path: Every failed or unobserved ETF allocation follows one deterministic route: no trade, then the affected notional remains in the eligible protected-liquidity reserve. Staging cash never exceeds CNY10000, and no failure automatically increases 511010, another ETF, REITs or direct stocks.
warnings: This defines research-model target notionals and sequencing, not broker order instructions, a price target, a guaranteed return, or a suitability determination.
No historical price snapshot is used for price, share quantity, premium/discount, spread, liquidity, or timing. Each ETF currently has q=0 until a complete current execution-day packet passes.
510880 and 512890 may have overlapping sector and constituent exposures. 512890 remains conditional until the dated combined-holdings test passes.

governance.quarterly: Measure weights, actual D0 cash receipts, product events, concentration and the documented observed drawdown.
governance.semiannual: Rebalance using new cash and actual distributions first; a deferred sleeve requires a fresh eligibility packet.
rebalance_review_triggers: protected-liquidity, rate-bond or total-equity weight differs from its target by more than 5 percentage points
staging cash exceeds its CNY10000 hard cap or is below target while scheduled tranches remain
gold differs from its target by more than 2 percentage points
any product exceeds a hard cap or fails an eligibility check
governance.observed_drawdown_definition: DD_t = (current portfolio market value after external-flow adjustment / documented high-water mark after external-flow adjustment) - 1, calculated from a dated account-value record. Scenario outputs do not trigger this control.
risk_actions: If observed DD_t is at or below -12%, stop automatic additions to risk sleeves and review.
If observed DD_t is at or below -18%, review liquidity, leverage, product abnormalities and capital purpose before any risk addition.
